name: usage-pacer
description: Lets Claude read your plan usage (5h / 7-day limits), context fill and session cost, wind down before a limit, and hand off to a fresh agent before the context fills.

handoffAt.title: Hand off at context %
handoffAt.description: Context percentage at which usage-pacer acts (whichever of this and the token count comes first). 0 turns this one off.

handoffTokens.title: Hand off at context tokens
handoffTokens.description: Context size in tokens at which usage-pacer acts (whichever of this and the percentage comes first). 0 turns this one off.

compactFirst.title: Compact once before handing off
compactFirst.description: The first time the level is reached, compact the conversation at the end of the turn so the task carries on; hand off only the next time.
